position_semantics.absolute_positions: Tracked per resident token monotonically and uniquely
position_semantics.total_tokens_seen: Cumulative monotonic counter across entire inference sequence
position_semantics.failure_atomicity: Pre-mutation validation ensures invalid, out-of-order, negative, float, or replayed evicted positions fail before any state or counter mutation
position_semantics.adapter_position_routing: Preserves absolute positions via kwargs, cache_kwargs, positional dicts, or active_positions_context channel

attention_and_masking.future_token_permission: -inf suppression for P_k > P_q (yields exact 0.0 softmax attention weight)
attention_and_masking.gqa_support: Grouped-Query Attention with H_q=9, H_kv=3 expanded via head repeat
attention_and_masking.rope_invariance: Keys preserve absolute position phase; rotary dot product invariant under intermediate eviction

dense_attention_lru_semantics.degeneracy_statement: Dense attention accesses every resident key on every step, rendering access-frequency/timestamp LRU degenerate. recency_window provides the well-defined token arrival recency baseline.

memory_accounting.payload_bytes_formula: 2 * H_kv * head_dim * dtype_bytes * num_layers * resident_tokens (derived directly from resident tensor allocations)
memory_accounting.peak_temporary_bytes_formula: Analytical summation of coexisting buffers during update (old_resident + incoming + concat + gathered + other_layers + metadata)
memory_accounting.temporary_memory_allowance: Explicit temporary_memory_allowance_bytes bound preflighted across update(), evict_to_capacity(), and evict_positions() raising MemoryError before state mutation if coexisting peak exceeds allowance
memory_accounting.authoritative_vs_allocator_snapshots: Analytical cache accounting is authoritative. Global accelerator snapshots reported separately under allocator_snapshot with global_process scope and post_update sampling point, never overriding analytical cache bounds. measured_peak_bytes remains null in the absence of an isolated cache measurement.
memory_accounting.budget_rejection_failure_atomicity: Rejected candidate bounds never update analytical_peak_bytes or set committed overflow flag; resident state, positions, counters, and peak history remain 100% unchanged, with diagnostics preserved in last_rejected_attempt.

limitations_and_deferred_scope.speedup_claims: None. Stage 06 is strictly an attention correctness and position contract gate.
limitations_and_deferred_scope.quality_ranking_claims: None. Bounded policies are not claimed superior in downstream quality.
limitations_and_deferred_scope.attention_selectors: Deferred to Stage 07 (selective eviction, heavy hitters).
limitations_and_deferred_scope.qualcomm_npu_execution: Deferred to Stage 11 (Qualcomm QNN / Hexagon deployment).
